title: Bledsoe prophecy of missiles fired at Iran stopped by entities

tellings.quote: sees a missiles being fired at the country of Iran
in my book you'll read where I wrote about a certain incident that was going to happen in future which was when Iran and Israel began to exchange missiles at one another
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Bledsoe, who says he wrote it in his book UFO of God, frames it as orbs appearing when Iran and Israel exchange missiles, and gives no 2026 date or Giza detail.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Bledsoe's prophecy of missiles exchanged with Iran and the involvement of the entities or orbs.

as_told.title: Prediction that orbs would appear when Iran and Israel exchanged missiles

tellings.quote: And she told me about the missiles that was in 2012.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Bledsoe, who says the Lady gave the warning in 2012, and does not name Iran in the quote.
tellings.link_reason: The Lady's warning to Bledsoe about missiles is the same missile prophecy that McGwier relays as missiles fired at Iran being stopped by entities.

tellings.quote: when the star of Regulus which is a blue star when it appears red on the horizon at the dawn uh before the sun comes up and the gaze of the spinx
tellings.difference: Focuses on the astronomical timing sign (Regulus appearing red at dawn in the Sphinx's gaze) instead of the missiles themselves.
tellings.link_reason: The Regulus-over-the-Sphinx sign for 2026 belongs to the same prophecy, which the story places at the pyramids at Giza in 2026.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had UFO encounters for years and meets a being he calls the Lady, says she warned him in 2012 about missiles in the future, and that he wrote in his book UFO of God of a time "when Iran and Israel began to exchange missiles at one another." He says the sign of the moment will be when the blue star Regulus appears red on the horizon at dawn, in the gaze of the Sphinx at Giza. Bob McGwier, an engineer described as a CIA contractor, retells it second-hand from Bledsoe as a vision of missiles fired at Iran and stopped by these beings, a version that has a 2026 date Bledsoe himself does not give.
